item.title: Victims identified following plane crash near Steamboat Springs
item.description: Authorities have revealed the names of four people who died after a single-engine airplane crashed into mountainous terrain near Steamboat Springs on Friday.

item.title: Man gets 40 years for trying have his wife killed while he was in jail
item.description: A Denver man received a 40-year prison sentence after trying to hire someone to kill his wife while he was in jail, the 18th Judicial District Attorney's Office announced.

item.title: Colorado bill would fully legalize prostitution
item.description: A bill introduced into the Colorado State Senate late last week would make Colorado the first state in the U.S. to fully decriminalize prostitution if it became law.
